gate_interpretation: Implementation, numerical validity and scientific efficacy are distinct. Passing a mechanism gate never overrides a failed scientific admission gate.

gates.name: shared_task_successors_and_actual_costs
gates.scope: Synchronous two-job evidence task; public schedule, exact posterior, budget, deadline, content and acknowledged task state.

gates.name: native_action_selection_before_real_content_read
gates.scope: Native policy selects STOP/SKIP/READ/FIRE before packet open. Only READ executes frozen FullHX.

gates.name: task_gradient_reaches_cell_dynamics
gates.scope: All 60 finite-difference task updates have nonzero physical and readout gradient after removing L2 contribution.

gates.name: trained_boundary_changes_real_reads
gates.scope: Secondary DEV intervention; 19/80 distinct sessions change actions, 11/80 actual read timing and 8/80 read count; no efficacy gain claimed.

gates.name: actual_outcomes_enter_training_update
gates.scope: Ten independent one-step critic TD updates change weights and reduce TRAIN residual; validation utility/regret unchanged. Main frozen fits are not replaced.

gates.name: acknowledged_boundary_process_recovery
gates.scope: Fresh-process recovery matches task, cell and content state at acknowledged action boundaries. Arbitrary mid-action recovery is not admitted.

gates.name: all_predeclared_confirmation_runs_complete
gates.scope: Five independent fits; 1200 native executions plus 240 separate fitted-law DP reference executions.

gates.name: native_continuous_diffusion_equivalence
gates.scope: Three active nodes plus two Erlang phases remain a finite CTMC. Trained-parameter first-hit absolute error is 0.127420 to 0.161888; continuous reference is independent and not deployed in the owner.
